scope: Teacher-facing flagship class loop and its shared navigation/recovery surfaces

common_rules.navigation: Every screen has an inline Back, Cancel, Done, or Main menu action; /start is never required.
common_rules.dense_entry: Ask at most one short free-text question per Telegram message. Reuse saved class fields and prefer buttons; a future Web App may replace multi-field setup but is not required for MVP.
common_rules.mutation: Show confirmation before destructive or irreversible actions and before applying AI-derived diagnoses.
common_rules.recovery: Answer every callback query. Preserve draft state on retry when safe; expired state routes to REC01.

screens.title: Home
screens.back: Main menu is the root; Account and legacy tools return here via inline action.
screens.empty: My Classes opens CLS01 when none exist.
screens.retry: Refresh repeats the read without creating state.
screens.confirmation: Not required.
screens.recovery: REC01 if the keyboard is stale.

screens.title: My Classes — empty
screens.empty: Explain the benefit and minimum setup; never show a blank list.
screens.retry: Refresh list.
screens.confirmation: Not required.
screens.recovery: Offer legacy generators if class feature is disabled.

screens.title: My Classes — list
screens.empty: Route to CLS01.
screens.retry: Refresh list with stable pagination.
screens.confirmation: Not required.
screens.recovery: If selected class was deleted, explain and refresh list.

screens.title: Class setup — name
screens.back: CLS01 or CLS02; discard nothing without confirmation if a draft exists.
screens.empty: Show one example label; do not request student names.
screens.retry: Keep valid prior fields and ask only for the invalid field.
screens.confirmation: Confirm draft discard on Cancel.
screens.recovery: Resume the saved draft or start fresh.

screens.title: Class setup — profile
screens.primary: Choose level, learner-count band, and cadence with buttons
screens.empty: Offer Unknown/Not sure where pedagogically safe.
screens.retry: Retain prior selections.
screens.confirmation: Not required.
screens.recovery: Resume setup draft.

screens.title: Class setup — goal
screens.primary: Choose goal then optionally add a short note
screens.empty: General English is available but not silently assumed.
screens.retry: Retain profile selections.
screens.confirmation: Not required.
screens.recovery: Resume setup draft.

screens.title: Class setup — review
screens.back: CLS05 or edit a named field.
screens.empty: Cannot occur; missing required fields route to their step.
screens.retry: Idempotently retry the create transaction.
screens.confirmation: Teacher confirms exact stored profile and privacy reminder.
screens.recovery: If creation already succeeded, open CLS07 instead of duplicating.

screens.title: Class home
screens.empty: Show Create first plan with a short explanation.
screens.retry: Refresh class timeline.
screens.confirmation: Not required.
screens.recovery: Read-only screen if entitlement or flag changes; Export/Delete remain available.

screens.title: Plan brief
screens.primary: Confirm goal, duration, and resource type using saved class context
screens.empty: Use class goal as an editable suggestion.
screens.retry: Keep selections after validation errors.
screens.confirmation: Generate button summarizes the brief.
screens.recovery: Offer legacy generator if class planning is disabled.

screens.title: Generating class resource
screens.back: Cancel returns to PLN01 without consuming quota unless a resource committed.
screens.empty: Not applicable.
screens.retry: Retry with same idempotency key after a transient failure.
screens.confirmation: Not required.
screens.recovery: On timeout show PLN04; never leave a dead spinner.

screens.title: Resource preview
screens.back: PLN01 to edit brief or CLS07 when saved.
screens.empty: Cannot occur; missing output is an error.
screens.retry: Regenerate creates a version, not a duplicate loop.
screens.confirmation: Confirm Save/Use; identify AI-generated status.
screens.recovery: Export or delete remains available if the loop feature is disabled.

screens.title: Generation failed
screens.back: PLN01 with brief preserved; CLS07 via Cancel.
screens.empty: Not applicable.
screens.retry: Use same request key for unknown outcomes; new key only after confirmed failure.
screens.confirmation: Warn before a retry that would consume another quota unit.
screens.recovery: Offer a copyable brief and legacy generator.

screens.title: Mark lesson taught
screens.primary: Confirm taught today or choose date
screens.empty: If no planned resource exists, route to PLN01.
screens.retry: Idempotent taught-status update.
screens.confirmation: Explicit confirmation; never infer teaching from download/export.
screens.recovery: If already taught, open OUT01.

screens.title: 30-second outcome
screens.primary: Tap goal result, confidence, and support-needed bands
screens.empty: Three button groups plus Skip evidence for now; no essay box.
screens.retry: Retain selections and retry save.
screens.confirmation: Review chips before Save.
screens.recovery: Resume incomplete outcome from class home.

screens.title: Outcome saved
screens.empty: If evidence is skipped, show Continue later and the pending-loop state.
screens.retry: Not applicable; save is idempotent.
screens.confirmation: Success includes what was stored.
screens.recovery: Edit outcome before evidence approval.

screens.title: Evidence privacy and consent
screens.primary: Choose evidence type and consent to processing
screens.empty: Explain allowed formats, redaction, retention, and that student names must be removed.
screens.retry: Re-display policy without losing loop state.
screens.confirmation: Separate affirmative consent; no preselected consent.
screens.recovery: Continue without evidence remains available.

screens.title: Evidence upload
screens.primary: Upload one permitted artifact or enter structured counts
screens.back: EVD01; revoke consent for uncommitted upload.
screens.empty: Offer a privacy-safe structured alternative.
screens.retry: Retry upload; reject unsupported/oversize files with exact limits.
screens.confirmation: Show received file type and retention choice before processing.
screens.recovery: Discard partial upload and return to EVD01.

screens.title: Processing evidence
screens.back: Cancel processing and delete temporary artifacts.
screens.empty: Not applicable.
screens.retry: Retry from stored upload only within consented temporary-retention window.
screens.confirmation: Not required.
screens.recovery: Timeout routes to EVD05 with delete/retry choices.

screens.title: Review extracted evidence
screens.back: EVD02; warn that edits may be lost.
screens.empty: If nothing reliable was extracted, route to EVD05 rather than inventing findings.
screens.retry: Reprocess or switch to manual structured counts.
screens.confirmation: Approval is mandatory before any diagnosis uses the evidence.
screens.recovery: Delete raw evidence while retaining an explicitly approved summary only by teacher choice.

screens.title: Evidence needs attention
screens.primary: Retry, enter structured counts, or delete
screens.empty: Explain that no diagnosis was created.
screens.retry: Retry only after stating the failure category.
screens.confirmation: Delete confirmation for uploaded artifacts.
screens.recovery: Close as no-evidence pending loop.

screens.title: Proposed diagnosis
screens.empty: No diagnosis if evidence is insufficient; show a neutral next-step option.
screens.retry: Regenerate only from the approved evidence version.
screens.confirmation: Teacher approval is mandatory; language says proposal, not fact.
screens.recovery: Revision mismatch reloads the newest evidence and proposal.

screens.title: Diagnosis approved
screens.back: DIA01 to revise; revision invalidates unaccepted follow-up.
screens.empty: Not applicable.
screens.retry: Idempotent approval.
screens.confirmation: Show evidence version and teacher-control status.
screens.recovery: Class home exposes Revise diagnosis.

screens.title: Follow-up proposal
screens.primary: Accept, edit, or reject next teaching action
screens.empty: If no safe proposal is available, offer teacher-authored follow-up.
screens.retry: Regenerate from the approved diagnosis version.
screens.confirmation: Accept summarizes action and affected next lesson.
screens.recovery: Reject never changes class state; teacher can author a replacement.

screens.title: Follow-up accepted
screens.empty: Not applicable.
screens.retry: Idempotent acceptance.
screens.confirmation: Success states that no lesson changed yet.
screens.recovery: If planning is unavailable, save follow-up as pending and notify the teacher.

screens.title: Next lesson brief
screens.empty: Prepopulate from class profile and accepted follow-up; all fields editable.
screens.retry: Keep accepted follow-up and brief.
screens.confirmation: Show how the follow-up affects the brief.
screens.recovery: Teacher can detach the follow-up without deleting it.

screens.title: Loop complete
screens.empty: Cannot occur until next resource commits.
screens.retry: Do not emit a second loop_completed event.
screens.confirmation: Name every completed stage and pending next action.
screens.recovery: If event emission fails, outbox retries without blocking the saved resource.

screens.title: Class resources
screens.empty: Offer Plan next lesson.
screens.retry: Refresh stable pagination.
screens.confirmation: Not required.
screens.recovery: Deleted item disappears and list refreshes.

screens.title: Account and data controls
screens.primary: Open plan, usage, privacy, export, or deletion
screens.empty: Not applicable.
screens.retry: Refresh entitlement.
screens.confirmation: Destructive options route to dedicated confirmation.
screens.recovery: Plan lookup failure does not block data export/deletion.

screens.title: Delete evidence or resource
screens.back: Return to owning detail screen with no mutation.
screens.empty: If already deleted, report success idempotently.
screens.retry: Retry same deletion key.
screens.confirmation: Required; list exact content and downstream effects.
screens.recovery: Ownership failure reveals no object details and returns to safe list.

screens.title: Delete class
screens.empty: If already deleted, route to CLS02.
screens.retry: Resume purge job without duplicating it.
screens.confirmation: Two-step confirmation and choice for independently saved resource copies.
screens.recovery: During seven-day metadata window show deletion status, not class content.

screens.title: Deletion result
screens.back: CLS02, LIB01, or ACC01 based on deleted object.
screens.empty: Not applicable.
screens.retry: Show pending purge status and retry only failed storage tasks.
screens.confirmation: Receipt includes scope and completion deadline, no deleted content.
screens.recovery: Support reference uses random deletion job ID, never classroom text.

screens.title: Session changed or expired
screens.primary: Return to current class or Home
screens.empty: Explain that no new change was made.
screens.retry: Reload the current object and issue a fresh revisioned keyboard.
screens.confirmation: Not required.
screens.recovery: Always provide a fresh inline Home action; no slash command is necessary.

screens.title: Temporary service error
screens.back: Return to last stable screen or Home.
screens.empty: State whether the previous action committed, if known.
screens.retry: Idempotent for mutations; read-only refresh otherwise.
screens.confirmation: Warn only if a confirmed new billable generation is necessary.
screens.recovery: Provide a support reference with no private payload.
